lines.trans: They suddenly moved our filming to tomorrow.
And we need to answer urgently.
They want to film tomorrow, what should we do?
After all, Eleonora forbade everything.
Agree to it, tomorrow she will be gone all day.
She will even thank you afterward.
Alright, come tomorrow.
The crew will be at our place at four o'clock.
It is no star, of course, but it is already something.
Let's go celebrate, I will catch up right now.
Thank you for the help, friend.
As we say in Russia, one good turn deserves another.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'оглашаться').
